name: Credit Cards
overview: Scripture warns believers to exercise careful stewardship and avoid the bondage of debt, as the borrower becomes servant to the lender (Proverbs 22:7) and we are instructed to owe no one except to love (Romans 13:8). Wise planning and counting the cost before committing financially is encouraged (Luke 14:28), while coveting what belongs to others is clearly forbidden (Deuteronomy 5:21). Faithfulness in managing earthly resources reflects our trustworthiness with true riches (Luke 16:11), reminding us to honor God in all financial dealings.
